listing.name: TheDarkSix Ship & Weapon Pack (aka TDS) 1.73-HF3 (UPD 30.06.26)
listing.summary: Chinasector mod translated into english. Features all kinds of boats, from frigates to supercapitals. Weapons range from rather underpowered to good damage dealers.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a variety of ships and weapons, ranging from frigates to supercapitals, with various hull modifications.

description: Features a wide array of vessels including special battleships like the Colossus class with built-in main weapons. Includes low-tech heavy shield armor ships and high-tech medium shield armor carriers equipped with guided energy torpedoes. The pack also offers rebalanced weapon values, adjusted carrier-based aircraft, and modified ship weapon firing ranges.

discordPostHtml:
Chinasector mod translated into english. Features all kinds of boats, from frigates to supercapitals.
Weapons range from rather underpowered to good damage dealers.
Dunno what else to say here. Hullmods are kinda cool.

Older version was posted with barebones translation back in 2025, which also featured a crash associated with one of the LPCs. Works fine now.

changelog.1.73-HF3:
Fixed several localization issues, names of a few variants got scrambled into gibberish:
 contaminate-tds_N.variant
indignation-tds_N.variant
owl-tds_N.variant
 I've also somewhat rewritten descriptions and codex entries and such, should be far more comprehensive now.
There were also some chunks of garbled text in there too, gone as well now, hopefully (I apologize in advance for my poor eyesight)
changelog.1.73-HF2: Fixed the naming in ship_data. Names should show properly
changelog.1.73-HF1:
Some hulls which were supposed to be phase ships didn't have a phasefield hullmod on them, which could cause a crash while mousing over\installing hullmods which affect phasing.
 These now have the required hullmod:
 Amberelder
Irenaeus Lp
Windsspawn
Hippolytus Lp
Ithaqua
Epiphanius Lp
Deathwalker
Deathwalker Xiv
Gnostic Lp
 Should be safe compatible!
 If you find any more issues - please let me know, I will try fixing it and will also let the original author know about the issue.
